main_text.p: Stridere] Valido stridore impulit fores, Val. Arg. Flagitium magnum fecêre fores, Plaut. Frendere dentibus, Idem.
Stridor] Argutatio lecti, Catul. Strepitus januæ, Hor. Crepitus fo-rium, Plaut. Sonus raucus cardinis, Propert. Querela foriū, Ovid. Dentium inter se arietatorum sonitus.
Stridulus] Stridulum plaustrum, Ovid. Stridens serra, Lucr. Crepax mola, Sen.

Strigosus] Strigosissimi corporis capra, Col. Junceus, Ter. Uvis aridior. Exsuctus, Scal. Passos senes, vocat Lucil. Apricos, Perf. Corpora sicciora cornu habetis, Catul. Lignea conjux, Id. i. Gracilis & exsucci corporis, Sen.
Stringere, vid. Comprimere. Strophiolum, vid. Muccinium.
Structor, qui fercula disponit] Fercula struens, Col. Instructor convivii, Cic. TriclinIarcha, Fulv. Analectes, Sen. Diætarius, Vlp. vid. aliter Ædificator.
Struma] Tumor gutturis, Celf. Intumescit guttur aquarum certarum vitio, Plin. Gutturis propendula struma, Philand.
Strumosus] Strumaticus, Firm. Gutturosus, Vlp. Gutture turgido, Vitruv. Glandulosa cervix suis, Col. Glandulosus sus, Gar.
Struthiocamelus] Struthocamelus, Plin. Struthio, abs. Hieron. Isidor. jun. Passer marinus. Pœna (punica) avis, Plin. Afra avis, Acron. Avis non avis, Aldromand.

Studere] Studere literas, & literis. Dare operam studio juris. Versari in artibus ingenuis: in studio literarum. Addiscere aliquid. Incumbere in, ad studia. Referre se ad studia, Cic. Discere aliquid apud aliquem: de aliquo: Discere fidibus, Id. Litare Musis. Dare se literis, vel ad literas.

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the margins and between lines; not transcribed. Some words in the Greek-free entries are uncertain due to scan blur, e.g. "Triclinιarcha" read as "Tricliniarcha" and "Querela foriū" as printed.
